segments.an4.115:2.1: “Tatra, bhikkhave, yamidaṃ [yadidaṃ (syā. kaṃ. ka.)] ṭhānaṃ amanāpaṃ kātuṃ;
segments.an4.115:2.2: tañca kayiramānaṃ anatthāya saṃvattati – idaṃ, bhikkhave, ṭhānaṃ ubhayeneva na kattabbaṃ maññati [paññāyati (?)].
segments.an4.115:2.5: imināpi naṃ [taṃ (sī. pī.) syāmapotthake natthi] na kattabbaṃ maññati.
segments.an4.115:2.7: imināpi naṃ [taṃ (pī.) sī. syā. potthakesu natthi] na kattabbaṃ maññati.
segments.an4.115:2.8: Idaṃ, bhikkhave, ṭhānaṃ ubhayeneva na kattabbaṃ maññati.
segments.an4.115:3.2: tañca kayiramānaṃ atthāya saṃvattati – imasmiṃ, bhikkhave, ṭhāne bālo ca paṇḍito ca veditabbo purisathāme purisavīriye purisaparakkame.
segments.an4.115:3.6: atha carahidaṃ ṭhānaṃ kayiramānaṃ atthāya saṃvattatī’ti.
segments.an4.115:3.8: Tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ akayiramānaṃ anatthāya saṃvattati.
segments.an4.115:3.9: Paṇḍito ca kho, bhikkhave, iti paṭisañcikkhati –
segments.an4.115:3.11: atha carahidaṃ ṭhānaṃ kayiramānaṃ atthāya saṃvattatī’ti.
segments.an4.115:3.13: Tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ kayiramānaṃ atthāya saṃvattati.
segments.an4.115:4.1: “Tatra, bhikkhave, yamidaṃ [yadidaṃ (syā. kaṃ.)] ṭhānaṃ manāpaṃ kātuṃ;
segments.an4.115:4.2: tañca kayiramānaṃ anatthāya saṃvattati – imasmimpi, bhikkhave, ṭhāne bālo ca paṇḍito ca veditabbo purisathāme purisavīriye purisaparakkame.
segments.an4.115:4.6: atha carahidaṃ ṭhānaṃ kayiramānaṃ anatthāya saṃvattatī’ti.
segments.an4.115:4.8: Tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ kayiramānaṃ anatthāya saṃvattati.
segments.an4.115:4.9: Paṇḍito ca kho, bhikkhave, iti paṭisañcikkhati –
segments.an4.115:4.11: atha carahidaṃ ṭhānaṃ kayiramānaṃ anatthāya saṃvattatī’ti.
segments.an4.115:4.13: Tassa taṃ ṭhānaṃ akayiramānaṃ atthāya saṃvattati.
segments.an4.115:5.1: “Tatra, bhikkhave, yamidaṃ ṭhānaṃ manāpaṃ kātuṃ, tañca kayiramānaṃ atthāya saṃvattati – idaṃ, bhikkhave, ṭhānaṃ ubhayeneva kattabbaṃ maññati.
segments.an4.115:5.3: Yampidaṃ ṭhānaṃ manāpaṃ kātuṃ, imināpi naṃ kattabbaṃ maññati;
segments.an4.115:5.4: yampidaṃ ṭhānaṃ kayiramānaṃ atthāya saṃvattati, imināpi naṃ kattabbaṃ maññati.
segments.an4.115:5.5: Idaṃ, bhikkhave, ṭhānaṃ ubhayeneva kattabbaṃ maññati.

lines: Ettha ca paṭhamaṃ opātakkhaṇanamacchabandhanasandhicchedanādibhedaṃ sadukkhaṃ savighātaṃ pāpakammaṃ veditabbaṃ, dutiyaṃ samajīvikānaṃ gihīnaṃ pupphacchaḍḍakādikammaṃ sudhākoṭṭana-gehacchādanaasuciṭṭhānasammajjanādikammañca veditabbaṃ, tatiyaṃ surāpānagandhavilepanamālāpiḷandhanādikammañceva assādavasena pavattaṃ pāṇātipātādikammañca veditabbaṃ, catutthaṃ dhammassavanatthāya gamanakāle suddhavatthacchādana-mālāgandhādīnaṃ ādāya gamanaṃ cetiyavandanaṃ bodhivandanaṃ madhuradhammakathāsavanaṃ pañcasīlasamādānanti evamādīsu somanassasampayuttaṃ kusalakammaṃ veditabbaṃ.
